title: Secrets: Five Days Before Christmas, 1990
subtitle: I've asked my aunt to tell me this story at least fifteen times.
quote: My story begins in 1990, five days before Christmas.

captions.instagram:
“My story begins in 1990, five days before Christmas.”

A Christmas tree sprayed with fake snow. A hand-carved mantel shipped over from London. My mother, nine months pregnant, slipping out of the room while her family half watched sports highlights. And my aunt, the only one who got up to look for her.

From Secrets: Five Days Before Christmas, 1990, on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
